language.script: Burmese script — a Brahmic-derived abugida with distinctive rounded, circular letterforms (rounded to avoid tearing traditional palm-leaf manuscripts)

terrainDescription.zh: 北部與東部為山地（撣邦高原環繞），伊洛瓦底江流域是農業核心地帶，西部與南部則有綿長的孟加拉灣／安達曼海岸線。
terrainDescription.en: Mountainous terrain rings the north and east (Shan Hills), the Irrawaddy river valley forms the agricultural core, and a long Bay of Bengal/Andaman coastline runs along the west and south.

plate.color: black text on white background (private vehicles, current format since July 2021); other colors by vehicle type (yellow-on-black religious, blue-on-white touring, red-on-white hire)

historicalContext.zh: 緬甸文字圓滾的字形源自早期書寫於脆弱貝葉手稿上的傳統——直線筆畫容易撕破葉片。值得注意的是，緬甸雖靠右行駛，但約九成車輛是日本進口的右駕二手車，因此方向盤位置在此地不是可靠的辨識線索。
historicalContext.en: Burmese script's distinctive circular letterforms trace back to writing on fragile palm-leaf manuscripts, where straight lines would tear the leaf. A quirk worth knowing: Myanmar drives on the right, but roughly 90% of vehicles are secondhand right-hand-drive imports from Japan — so steering-wheel position is not a reliable clue here.
